underlying_release: libxml2 2.15.4 behind PHP 8.5.12 ext/xml (compat.c push-parser layer), source-built for both the coverage image and the AFL++ overlay
coverage_limit: One run records two line-coverage sources for the documented setInputString()/parse() call: Xdebug 3.5.3 executed lines in pear/xml_parser PHP source (XML/Parser.php; the Xdebug pseudo-line past the end of each first-loaded class file is removed) and Clang/LLVM source coverage of PHP 8.5.12 ext/xml (xml.c, compat.c) and source-built libxml2 2.15.4. The setInputFile()/setInput() cross-check runs in a separate process and is not counted. The package PHP lines are the same on both controls: XML_Parser dispatches every SAX event from ext/xml's C callbacks to the handler object, so its own code path does not depend on the document. AFL++ feedback comes from the native overlay: libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c, parserInternals.c and SAX2.c plus PHP 8.5.12 ext/xml/xml.c and ext/xml/compat.c, instrumented through an allowlist while the same harness runs; the interpreted XML_Parser and PEAR code, ext/libxml/libxml.c, libxml2 tree/XPath/dict code and the Zend engine add no AFL++ tuples. The pinned base image does not bundle php-fuzzer; replay is per case.
coverage: Xdebug executed line coverage in pear/xml_parser v1.3.8 PHP source plus Clang/LLVM source coverage of PHP 8.5.12 ext/xml and source-built libxml2 2.15.4 during XML_Parser::setInputString() and parse() on a valid control; AFL++ feedback comes from the allowlisted libxml2 XML parser sources and ext/xml xml.c/compat.c in the native overlay
observable_limits: Raw-name SAX summary: XML_Parser 1.3.8 creates its parser with xml_parser_create() and has no namespace mode (its own docblock lists XML_Parser_Namespace as a todo), so names are raw qualified names, no namespace URI is resolved, and xmlns/xmlns:* declarations, including the xmlns="" undeclaration, arrive as ordinary attributes. The documented public $folding property is set to false; XML_Parser's default upper-cases every element and attribute name. Character data and CDATA share cdataHandler, so CDATA boundaries are not distinguished; text runs are flushed at element starts/ends and processing instructions, trimmed, and empty runs dropped. XML_Parser installs no comment handler and the harness defines no defaultHandler, so comments and the XML declaration are not reported. PHP 8.5 emits deprecation notices for XML_Parser's xml_set_object(), string handler names and xml_parser_free() calls; run-control.php records them, the harness suppresses only E_DEPRECATED, and the parse is unchanged. setInputString() feeds the whole control to one final xml_parse call; setInputFile() and setInput(resource) feed 4096-byte fread chunks (one chunk for these controls).
